primary_metric: mean accuracy across nine clean/noise/dropout/joint conditions, averaged across seeds
prior_art_status: Gradient features and spatial pooling are established handwriting-recognition/image-processing methods; no distinct relationship is established here. The claimed noise/dropout cancellation mechanism is mathematically incorrect under the proposal's stated independent corruption model.
limitations: Only three seeds on sklearn load_digits; exploratory pilot, no significance claim.
Proposal's original 80/20 split and five metric conditions were replaced by the repository's predeclared stratified 60/20/20 fixture and nine corruption conditions.
Four augmentation variants were operationalized as noise .2/.4 and dropout .15/.30; the proposal did not specify exact augmentation levels.
Inference time was not separately instrumented in this run; total training fits took about 0.15-0.46 s per seed/method.
Independent additive pixel noise increases difference-channel variance by factor 2; single-endpoint dropout affects a difference with probability 2p(1-p), not p^2.
